games.title: Folder Tidy-Up
games.skillName: Organising, saving and finding digital work
games.statutoryRequirement: Pupils should be taught to use technology purposefully to create, organise, store, manipulate and retrieve digital content
games.instruction: Think about keeping your work safe and tidy, then tap the best answer.
games.hint: Not quite. Think about how you would find your work again tomorrow, then try again.

questions.ask: Where can you keep lots of files together on a computer?
Which is the best file name for your story about a dragon?
What should you do so you don't lose your work?
How do you get back to work you saved yesterday?
You want to keep all your animal pictures together. What could you make?
When you click "Save as", what do you get to choose?
Why should you give your files sensible names?
Where does a photo usually go after you take it on a tablet?
What might happen if you close your work without saving it?
What do we keep inside a folder on a computer?
